scope: Turkish suffixes appended to technical terms, with and without apostrophes
interpretation: Ordinary technical chat forms; suffix orthography/pronunciation varies and corpus is not a prescriptive correctness claim. Five outputs change technical base/meaning, not merely apostrophe typography.
cause_scope: Known unrecognized technical term/suffix exposure; apostrophe guard protects all tested straight/curly/capitalized forms. No new distinct root cause claimed.
limits: Centered production-pack core typing, ordinary field, fresh profile each case; not live UI.
Do not recommend apostrophizing every technical term as the general fix.
Only these 80 forms; 60 passed apostrophe cases do not prove universal safety.
